item: Critical reagents brought from home in temperature-protected packaging
rationale: Reagents stored on site over winter were far outside their specified storage temperature range (15-30 C vs about -55 C in the habitat): the crew report says this may have affected some reagents and the coliform powder had solidified into a cake. The mission brief (not the crew) recommends not relying on on-site reagents for safety-critical or publication-quality measurements and bringing all critical reagents from home in temperature-protected packaging.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV §4.4 Scientific incidents, lines 713-718 ('Lesson for Hypatia III' at line 718; note this register row is tagged 'C15' in the brief, a known mis-tag - see event FMARS-C16-2024-EVT034); crew account placing it in Crew 16: SRC-flashline-crew-reports, FLASHLINE-16 SCIENCE REPORT-02 03-07-2024 (coliform test: kit storage limit 15-30 C vs habitat down to -55 C)
